## findings
- **SOURCE-POLICY RED F-1(b) (cite `_difficulty.md` → F-1).** Symptom: P6's patient-pay sentence waits on transfers for "every month that a standing authorization for patient pay covers and whose due day has passed"; P3 writes only the latest month. Evidence: standing authorization ba1bb878 / trust_accounts.standing_authorization medicaid_patient_pay; charges cc50f385 (2026-07), 10637375 (2026-08), 1653d6ea (2026-09) past due with no transfer naming them; P3 rule "the patient pay charge of the latest service month". Consequence: Reading A never reaches the waited-on state (no sign_withdrawal_request; hand-off/refusal) vs Reading B 1559.65 after P3. Affected: P6 rule sentence and prerequisite[0].condition; scored step 26.
- **XF 29 RED T1-X1 (moves the scored P3).** Seeded estimates 1389.70 ×4 ≠ medicaid_evt_pending_estimate on the case's own figures (1459.50 − 45.00 − 113.30 = 1301.20), and trueups of 113.30 imply an Aug–Oct notice amount (1276.40) that no record holds while the case records 1301.20 effective 2026-11-01. P3's 599.80 is computed from these rows (month_pp 1276.40, credited reconciliation 226.60). Affected: initial_state.medicaid_ledger estimates/trueups, medicaid_cases.37b0eb72; computations[P3]; F-9 (tier-1 sub-branch).
- **SOURCE-FACTOR RED T1-X2.** unapplied_patient_pay_payments rests on 230e0bdc (150.00, no charge named); medicaid_evt_payments applies an unallocated payment "oldest service month first" (→ cc50f385). On that producible row, unapplied = 0 and P3 = 599.80 unchanged — the factor does not bear weight. Also F-14.
- **SOURCE-FACTOR RED T1-X3.** block_days_past_coverage_end rests on block 48608009 booked through 2026-04-30 on 2026-05-01 although last_covered_date 2026-04-26 (NOMNC 04-24); medicare_evt_day_counting closes the month "early at the last covered date". On the producible booking (26 days), days_past_end = 0 and P5 = 759.50 unchanged — the factor does not bear weight. Also F-15.
- **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (F-6, F-8, F-9, F-14, F-17).** On this world: room_held_nightly_rate moves only against a semi-private baseline the bedhold charter contradicts (F-6); other_unsigned_bills_kept carries the unreal conjunct (F-8); named_month_patient_pay takes the F-9 sub-branch and block_benefit_day_count the F-9 numbering; nine of the 18 declared factors here are F-14 members; surviving counts P3 0, P4 1, P5 1, P6 3 (F-17).
